text:
Lina Park: Hey folks :wave: Today is my first day joining Redwood Inference as a Product Analyst on Platform. Quick Qs: who do I talk to about getting a desk badge and MDM enrollment? Also where do people grab tea/afternoon snacks around here?
Claire Wong: welcome Lina!! :tada: ping me for badge pickup (I run reception on Wednesdays). For MDM, open the internal setup doc and click the 'Start Device Enrollment' button.
Lina Park: thanks Claire — I clicked it but get a 403 when hitting the enroll link.
Rajiv Menon: 403 usually means the device claim wasn't created. @Onboard Bot, can you check claim status for lina.park@redwood.ai?
Onboard Bot: Device claim not found for lina.park@redwood.ai. Created provisional claim and resent enrollment link at 2012345685.
Lina Park: got the email, enrollment started. it asked for a company code — where do I find that?
Claire Wong: code is in the onboarding doc (top of page) or ask devex if it's missing. it's case-sensitive.
Sofia Alvarez: afternoon snacks = kitchen pantry, but low-key pro tip: the coffee cart rolls by Thursdays. Also we have a regular pastry rotation in eng on Fridays.
Lina Park: pastry rotation noted. fun fact about me: I used to map hiking trails for a park service.
Rajiv Menon: love that. we have a few hikers here. welcome aboard! if MDM finishes and you still get blocked on internal apps ping me and I'll add you to the platform google group.
Lina Park: enrollment completed and badge pickup confirmed. thanks everyone :smile:
